hypothesis: In some types of non-Alzheimer's, non-aged human brain cells, APOE4 adheres more tightly to some recycling receptors than APOE3, impeding recycling.

paper.title: The Role of Impaired Receptor Trafficking in Mediating the Pathological Effects of APOE4 in Alzheimer's Disease.

findings.finding_description: Surface biotinylation followed by ELISA showed that the surface-to-total ratio of APOER2 was 53% lower in APOE4 than in APOE3 targeted-replacement primary neurons. Reduced surface fraction is only a surrogate for impaired recycling; receptor binding affinity was not measured.
findings.quote: The results obtained show that the ratio of the externally oriented receptors to the total, was significantly lower in APOE4 neurons of APOER2 (Fig. 4A, 53% reduction, p < 0.05)
findings.summary: APOE4 neurons display about half the surface fraction of APOER2 seen in APOE3 neurons.
findings.experimental_system: primary neurons from humanized APOE3/APOE4 targeted-replacement mice (α-syn-/- background)

findings.finding_description: Double staining for APOER2 and Rab5 with M1 colocalization analysis showed more APOER2 in early endosomes in APOE4 neurons (0.50) than in APOE3 neurons (0.37). This is consistent with receptor retention in early endosomes and impaired recycling, but recycling flux and binding were not measured.
findings.quote: more APOER2 is localized in the early endosomes in APOE4 cells as indicated by the M1 colocalization variable described in the material and methods section (0.50±0.03, N = 31 from 3 different preparations) than in the APOE3 cells (0.37±0.04, N = 20 from 3 different preparations) neurons (p < 0.05).
findings.summary: APOER2 accumulates in Rab5+ early endosomes in APOE4 neurons.
findings.experimental_system: primary neurons from humanized APOE3/APOE4 targeted-replacement mice

findings.finding_description: Surface biotinylation followed by ELISA showed that the LRP1 surface-to-total ratio was 48.03% lower in APOE4 than in APOE3 neurons. This is a surrogate for impaired recycling.
findings.quote: and LRP1 (Fig. 4B, 48.03% reduction, p < 0.05) than those of the corresponding APOE3 cells.
findings.summary: APOE4 neurons have a reduced LRP1 surface fraction.
findings.experimental_system: primary neurons from humanized APOE3/APOE4 targeted-replacement mice

findings.finding_description: M1 colocalization showed less LRP1 in Rab5+ early endosomes in APOE4 neurons (0.11) than in APOE3 neurons (0.24). This is opposite to the endosomal-trapping pattern and argues against early-endosome retention of LRP1.
findings.quote: revealed that there is a greater localization of LRP1 in early endosomes in APOE3 neurons (0.24±0.02, N = 21 from 2 different preparations) compared to APOE4 (0.11±0.016, N = 27 from 2 different preparations). This difference between the APOE4 and the APOE3 cells is highly significant (p < 0.001).
findings.summary: LRP1 is depleted, not trapped, in early endosomes of APOE4 neurons.
findings.experimental_system: primary neurons from humanized APOE3/APOE4 targeted-replacement mice

findings.finding_description: The surface-to-total ratio of insulin receptor showed a non-significant reduction in APOE4 neurons (28.77%, p=0.07).
findings.quote: Similar, though less prominent, pattern was evident in IR (Fig. 4 C, 28.77% reduction, p = 0.07)
findings.summary: IR surface fraction trended lower in APOE4 neurons, but the difference was not significant.
findings.experimental_system: primary neurons from humanized APOE3/APOE4 targeted-replacement mice

findings.finding_description: The VEGFR surface-to-total ratio was only slightly and non-significantly reduced in APOE4 neurons (9.90%, p=0.15).
findings.quote: and VEGFR (Fig. 4D, 9.90% reduction, p = 0.15).
findings.summary: There was no significant APOE4 effect on the VEGFR surface fraction.
findings.experimental_system: primary neurons from humanized APOE3/APOE4 targeted-replacement mice

findings.finding_description: Immunofluorescence IOD showed lower total LRP1 (32.05%) and APOER2 (39.26%) levels in APOE4 than in APOE3 neurons. This is a distal surrogate, compatible with degradation of receptors rather than recycling.
findings.quote: This analysis revealed significant decrease in the levels of both LRP1 (Fig. 2A) (32.05% reduction, p < 0.05) and APOER2 (Fig. 2B) (39.26% reduction, p < 0.0001) in the APOE4 neurons, in comparison to APOE3 neurons.
findings.summary: Total ApoE receptor levels are reduced in APOE4 neurons.
findings.experimental_system: primary neurons from humanized APOE3/APOE4 targeted-replacement mice

findings.finding_description: Immunofluorescence showed lower total IR (40%) and VEGFR (30.73%) levels in APOE4 neurons. This is only a distal surrogate for receptor trafficking.
findings.quote: These results indicate that the levels of both IR and VEGFR are lower in APOE4 neurons when compared to APOE3 neurons (IR: 40% decrease, p < 0.05. VEGFR:30.73% decrease, p < 0.05).
findings.summary: Total growth factor receptor levels are reduced in APOE4 neurons.
findings.experimental_system: primary neurons from humanized APOE3/APOE4 targeted-replacement mice

findings.finding_description: Confocal M1 colocalization of APOER2 with early endosomes was compared between APOE4 and APOE3 primary neurons. APOE4 neurons had more APOER2 in early endosomes (0.50±0.03) than APOE3 neurons (0.37±0.04). This is consistent with a trafficking block of an ApoE recycling receptor, but binding affinity and recycling rate were not measured.
findings.quote: more APOER2 is localized in the early endosomes in APOE4 cells as indicated by the M1 colocalization variable described in the material and methods section (0.50±0.03, N = 31 from 3 different preparations) than in the APOE3 cells (0.37±0.04, N = 20 from 3 different preparations) neurons (p < 0.05)
findings.summary: APOER2 accumulates in early endosomes of APOE4 vs APOE3 neurons (~1.35x).
findings.experimental_system: primary neuronal cultures from APOE3 vs APOE4 mice (human APOE isoforms in mouse neurons)

findings.finding_description: APOER2 colocalization with Rab11-positive recycling endosomes was compared between APOE4 and APOE3 neurons. The 11.16% decrease in APOE4 neurons was not significant (p=0.5154), so there is no direct evidence of reduced APOER2 in the recycling compartment.
findings.quote: and in the recycling endosomes in all three receptors (APOER2 : 11.16% decrease, p = 0.5154; IR: 30.88% decrease, p < 0.05; VEGFR: 29.02% decrease, p < 0.05)
findings.summary: APOER2 in recycling endosomes is not significantly changed by APOE4.
findings.experimental_system: primary neuronal cultures from APOE3 vs APOE4 mice

findings.finding_description: LRP1 colocalization with early endosomes was lower in APOE4 than APOE3 neurons (0.11 vs 0.24), and LRP1 in recycling endosomes did not differ by genotype. This argues against APOE4 trapping LRP1 in the recycling pathway.
findings.quote: there is a greater localization of LRP1 in early endosomes in APOE3 neurons (0.24±0.02, N = 21 from 2 different preparations) compared to APOE4 (0.11±0.016, N = 27 from 2 different preparations). This difference between the APOE4 and the APOE3 cells is highly significant (p < 0.001).
findings.summary: LRP1 is less, not more, localized to early endosomes in APOE4 neurons, arguing against trapping for this receptor.
findings.experimental_system: primary neuronal cultures from APOE3 vs APOE4 mice

findings.finding_description: The areas of Rab11 recycling endosomes and Rab5 early endosomes did not differ between APOE4 and APOE3 neurons, whereas late endosome and lysosome areas were reduced. The authors suggest this points to a degradation-pathway rather than recycling-pathway defect.
findings.quote: the levels of the early endosomes (APOE3 = 1.00±0.03, APOE4 = 1.1±0.05, p = 0.30) and recycling endosomes (APOE3 = 1.00±0.06, APOE4 = 0.94±0.07, p = 0.56) were not affected by APOE4.
findings.summary: Recycling endosome size is unaffected by APOE4, a null result against a gross recycling defect.
findings.experimental_system: primary neuronal cultures from APOE3 vs APOE4 mice

findings.finding_description: APOE-KO neurons were given equal 100 nM doses of recombinant APOE3 or APOE4 for 2 h. APOE3 roughly doubled APOER2 levels, whereas APOE4 did not. This supports an intrinsic isoform difference in receptor handling, but binding was not measured.
findings.quote: APOER2 (Control = 1.00±0.09, recombinant APOE3 = 2.08±0.27, recombinant APOE4 = 0.1.16±0.15, p < 0.01 when comparing recombinant3 with both control and recombinant4, N = 20 from 2 different preparations)
findings.summary: At equal doses, APOE3 but not APOE4 raises APOER2 levels in APOE-KO neurons.
findings.experimental_system: APOE-KO mouse primary neurons treated with recombinant human APOE3 or APOE4

findings.finding_description: APOER2 colocalization with lysosomes was lower in APOE4 neurons, and late endosome colocalization showed a non-significant trend toward reduction. The authors interpret both as downstream of an early endosomal trafficking block.
findings.summary: Less APOER2 reaches lysosomes in APOE4 neurons.
findings.experimental_system: primary neuronal cultures from APOE3 vs APOE4 mice

findings.finding_description: In APOE4 neurons, CRISPR knockdown of LRP1 abolished the excess APOER2 colocalization with early endosomes (0.44 to 0.20). Class 5: the perturbation is of a receptor, not of APOE genotype, and binding was not measured.
findings.quote: APOER2- APOE4 control = 0.44±0.02, APOE4-LRP1 AAv = 0.20±0.02, p < 0.0001, N = 50–53 from 5 different preparations.
findings.summary: LRP1 knockdown relieves APOER2 early-endosome accumulation in APOE4 neurons.
findings.experimental_system: APOE4 mouse primary neurons with CRISPR/Cas9 LRP1 knockdown

findings.finding_description: In APOE4 but not APOE3 neurons, APOER2 knockdown reduced IR and VEGFR colocalization with early endosomes. The authors take this to implicate the APOE4–APOER2 interaction. Class 5: the receptor was perturbed rather than APOE genotype, and binding was not measured.
findings.quote: These findings suggest that the interaction between APOER2 and APOE4 plays a significant role in downregulating IR and VEGFR in APOE4 neurons.
findings.summary: APOER2 knockdown reverses APOE4-specific early-endosome trapping of IR and VEGFR.
findings.experimental_system: APOE3/APOE4 mouse primary neurons with CRISPR/Cas9 APOER2 knockdown

findings.finding_description: IR and VEGFR, which are not ApoE recycling receptors, showed higher early endosome colocalization in APOE4 neurons. The rise was 0.28 to 0.36 for IR and 0.24 to 0.39 for VEGFR.
findings.quote: the colocalization of IR with early endosomes was significantly higher in APOE4 neurons (0.36±0.02, N = 34 from 4 different preparations) than in the APOE3 neurons (0.28±0.02, N = 48, from 4 different preparations, p < 0.05)
findings.summary: Growth factor receptors also accumulate in early endosomes in APOE4 neurons.
findings.experimental_system: primary neuronal cultures from APOE3 vs APOE4 mice

findings.finding_description: Secreted ApoE was 52.1% lower in conditioned media of APOE4 cultures. This is a level confound for the genotype comparisons.
findings.quote: in the APOE4 primary neuronal cultures the levels of ApoE are significantly lower than those of the APOE3 cultures (52.1% decrease, p < 0.05, N = 3)
findings.summary: APOE4 cultures have about half the secreted ApoE, a confound for genotype effects.
findings.experimental_system: primary neuronal cultures from APOE3 vs APOE4 mice

findings.finding_description: APOE4 and APOE3 neurons were compared by receptor colocalization with endosomal compartments. APOER2, but not LRP1, accumulated specifically in early endosomes of APOE4 neurons, consistent with an APOE4-induced recycling block for APOER2. Receptor binding affinity was not measured; trafficking was inferred from colocalization.
findings.quote: This is also supported by the finding that APOER2, but bot LRP1, accumulate specifically in early endosomes of APOE4 neurons.
findings.summary: APOER2, but not LRP1, accumulates in early endosomes of APOE4 neurons.
findings.experimental_system: APOE4 vs APOE3 neurons (species/model not specified in this excerpt; not shown to be human or non-AD)

findings.finding_description: APOE4 did not affect LRP1 levels or its trafficking to specific compartments. This is a negative result for the generality of an APOE4-induced recycling block across ApoE receptors.
findings.quote: This renders LRP1 as a very fast endocytotic receptor and could be the reason why, unlike the other receptors, APOE4 does not affect LRP1, and its trafficking to specific compartments.
findings.summary: APOE4 does not alter LRP1 levels or compartmental trafficking (null result for this recycling receptor).
findings.experimental_system: APOE4 vs APOE3 neurons (species/model not specified in this excerpt)

findings.finding_description: APOER2 levels in late endosomes were decreased in APOE4 neurons. The authors interpret this as secondary to an APOER2 trafficking block in early endosomes, which they attribute to APOE4 binding to APOER2 and APOE4 structural lability at endosomal pH. Binding itself was not measured here.
findings.quote: The observed decreased level of APOER2 in late endosomes of the APOE4 neurons is most likely due to their trafficking block in early endosome.
findings.summary: APOE4 neurons show decreased APOER2 in late endosomes, interpreted as an early-endosome trafficking block.
findings.experimental_system: APOE4 vs APOE3 neurons (species/model not specified in this excerpt)

findings.finding_description: CRISPR/Cas9 knockdown of APOER2 in APOE4 neurons reversed the APOE4-driven decrease in IR and VEGFR levels and their altered colocalization with early endosomes. This implicates APOER2 as a mediator of APOE4-induced receptor trapping. The excerpt describes this as reversal of 'decreased colocalization with early endosomes', which is internally ambiguous given that endosomal trapping is described elsewhere.
findings.quote: In contrast, downregulation of APOER2, resulted in reversal of the APOE4 driven decrease in the levels of IR and VEGFR, as well as in their decreased colocalization with early endosomes.
findings.summary: APOER2 knockdown reverses APOE4-driven loss and endosomal mislocalization of IR and VEGFR.
findings.experimental_system: APOE4 neurons with CRISPR/Cas9 APOER2 knockdown (species/model not specified in this excerpt)

findings.finding_description: CRISPR/Cas9 knockdown of LRP1 did not change total levels of APOER2, VEGFR and IR, but reduced their colocalization with early endosomes. The authors interpret this as LRP1 participating in endosomal trapping of these receptors.
findings.quote: Knock-down of the LRP1 receptor utilizing CRISPR/Cas9 methodology revealed no effects on the total levels of APOER2, VEGFR and IR, but resulted in reduction of their colocalization with early endosomes.
findings.summary: LRP1 knockdown reduces early-endosome trapping of APOER2, VEGFR and IR without changing their levels.
findings.experimental_system: APOE4 neurons with CRISPR/Cas9 LRP1 knockdown (species/model not specified in this excerpt)

findings.finding_description: CRISPR/Cas9 knockdown of APOER2 affected neither LRP1 levels nor LRP1 colocalization with early endosomes. This indicates that LRP1 trafficking is independent of APOER2 in this system.
findings.quote: Neither the level of LRP1, nor their colocalization with early endosomes were affected by the knock-down of APOER2.
findings.summary: APOER2 knockdown has no effect on LRP1 levels or endosomal localization (null).
findings.experimental_system: APOE4 neurons with CRISPR/Cas9 APOER2 knockdown (species/model not specified in this excerpt)
